body:
This comment could probably be removed already.

Is there any potential case where RB_TEX_DEPTH's contents could potentially be requested at least in a future frame? Is that sort of functionality exposed to users and to fetch viewport contents several frames after they were rendered?

Correcting myself, this comment should stay. Transient bits are for adding textures without backing memory, not for marking them as discardable. This is a feature we haven't made use of anywhere in the codebase yet.

> Is there any potential case where RB_TEX_DEPTH's contents could potentially be requested at least in a future frame? Is that sort of functionality exposed to users and to fetch viewport contents several frames after they were rendered?

No, the depth is assumed to be unavailable once the frame ends

> Correcting myself, this comment should stay. Transient bits are for adding textures without backing memory, not for marking them as discardable. This is a feature we haven't made use of anywhere in the codebase yet.

That's right. We need to refactor in the future so that the renderer can request a non-transient texture when it knows depth will never be read back. But that will be a lot of work, so the TODO should stay
